title: 第8章 长留上仙白子画
slug: 花千骨全本免费-花千骨最新章节列表
content_zh:
花千骨看着他的脸发呆，这人笑起来怎么会这生好看，暖融融的让她好想睡觉哦！
“呃……人的世界，鬼的世界，妖魔的世界，还有神仙的世界？还有什么？”她扳起手指头来数，好像不够。
“差不多就是这几个，人界，冥界，妖界，魔界，仙界，还有神界。”
“哇，分这么详细啊……那冥界、妖界、魔界代表恶，人界、仙界、神界代表善对吧？两者相互制衡？清虚道长说的妖神要出世，是不是说妖界的最厉害的怪物要跑出来了？怪不得我看最近大白天的多了那么多妖怪。”
“六界并不是这么简单的善恶问题。人死为鬼入冥界，修炼的话成仙能位列仙班，而妖比较复杂，一般是自然物化的结果，动物，植物，甚至器皿由于自身或者外力的原因都有可能成精，形态更是千奇各异。至于魔界，不管是人也好，妖也好，仙也好，恶意、执念、天劫、练功走火皆有可能堕入魔道。”
“那神呢？人们总说神仙神仙，我一直以为神和仙是一个东西”
“上古众神与天地同生，而仙一般都是修炼而成，虽都有法力，但是并不一样。只是人们爱把他们说在一块，就好像爱把妖和魔，合起来说成妖魔一样。伏羲演八卦，女娲造人，西王母的蟠桃会，共工撞倒不周山，夸父逐日，精卫填海，仓颉造字，黄帝大战蚩尤，这些传说你都应该听过。只是，神仙妖魔虽然通过修炼可以长生不老，但都并不是不死之身。有的可以入轮回，到冥界进行投胎或转生，但是大多数都是直接寂灭。”
“说来说去，还是做人最苦最难啊！”
“非也，世间人的数量是最多的，其他族类只是很小一部分。人界看似最没有能力，其实是最强大的一个界，更是六界之源，万物之根本。”
“没发现做人强在哪好在哪啊？”
“人心的力量才是最强大的，你以后就会懂。而追求做人的更高层次，并不一定是做仙。所以你也没必要如此执着的去拜什么师、求什么道、修什么仙，不管是神仙还是妖魔，都各有各的烦恼，说不定还没做人来得简单快乐。”
花千骨觉得很有理的点点头。
“那清虚道长他们算是人还是仙呢？一开始他让我去参加什么群仙会我还想不通，我一个普通人，怎么去得了。”
“你没有看他给你的那个《六界全书》么？里面分类还有级别等应该都叙述的十分清楚。”
“还没有看，下月十三就是群仙宴了，到昆仑山那么远，我怕赶不上，这些天拼命的赶路，晚上一躺下就睡着了，根本就忘了那书的事了。”
“仙的等级依照法力和地位的不同一般可以分成九品：第一上仙，第二次仙，第三太上真人，第四飞天真人，第五灵仙，第六真人，第七灵人，第八飞仙，第九仙人。成仙的方式也有许多种，主要是佛道两家，通过修佛和修道两种途径。另外还有天仙，地仙和尸解仙等等，就是先死再成仙。还有通过外力吃仙药灌输仙力等方法，当然自己修炼白日飞升或者直接成仙是最好的。”
“哦，原来长留上仙是这么厉害的啊？”
“什么！？”东方彧卿眯起眼睛。
“清虚道长让我去拜长留上仙白子画为师。”
东方彧卿冷哼一声，温暖的眼睛突然变得有些倨傲，不知道为什么花千骨会突然觉得他有点熟悉。

“他们都成仙了，还会管这世俗中的事，还会收徒弟么？”以前她总感觉仙人是高高在上，很难见到的。
“如今这个世道，妖魔猖狂，得道成仙者和修真者之间几乎已经没什么太大界限了，除了天庭位于九天之上，其他成仙者，不管是有封位还是闲云野鹤的散仙，多居于山野桃源，海外仙岛的洞天福地，世人都可以去访仙求缘。说穿了，仙人根本没有世人所描述的那样高高在上，不可亵渎。只不过是比平常人多些法力，少点情欲罢了。一个偏颇，反而比人更容易堕入魔道。”
花千骨听他话里隐隐对仙人的不屑，一时不知道说什么好。那她的未来师父是个什么样的人呢？
“那清虚道长应该也是上仙吧？”
“他？应该是真人吧，你以为成仙那么容易？整个仙界现在上仙也不过仅余寥寥四人。”

content_en:
Hua Qiangu looked at his face in a daze. How could this man look so good-looking when he smiled? It was so warm that she wanted to sleep!
"Uh... the world of humans, the world of ghosts, the world of demons, and the world of gods? What else is there?" She counted on her fingers, but it seemed that it was not enough.
"That's pretty much it, the human world, the underworld, the demon world, the demon world, the fairy world, and the divine world."
"Wow, it's so detailed... Then the underworld, demon world, and demon world represent evil, and the human world, fairy world, and god world represent good, right? They check and balance each other? When Taoist Master Qingxu said that demon gods are about to be born, does that mean that the most powerful monsters in the demon world are about to escape? No wonder I see so many monsters in broad daylight recently."
"The six realms are not such a simple matter of good and evil. People die as ghosts and enter the underworld. If they practice cultivation, they can become immortals and rank among the immortals. Demons are more complex and are usually the result of natural materialization. Animals, plants, and even vessels may become spirits due to their own or external forces, and their shapes are even more bizarre. As for the demon world, whether it is a person, a demon, or an immortal, malice, obsession, catastrophe, or an accident during practice can all lead to falling into the devil's path."
"What about gods? People always talk about gods and immortals, but I always thought gods and immortals were the same thing."
"In ancient times, the gods were born at the same time as heaven and earth, and immortals were generally cultivated. Although they all have magical powers, they are not the same. It's just that people like to talk about them together, just like they like to talk about monsters and demons together as monsters. Fuxi performed Bagua, Nuwa created humans, Queen Mother of the West's Peach Club, Gonggong knocked down Mount Buzhou, Kua Fu chases the sun, Jing Wei fills the sea, Cang Jie creates characters, and Huang Di fights Chi You. You should have heard of these legends. However, although gods and demons can live forever through practice, some of them can enter reincarnation and reincarnate in the underworld, but most of them will die directly. "
"After all, being a human being is still the hardest and hardest!"
"No, the number of humans in the world is the largest, and other races are only a small part. The human world seems to be the least capable, but it is actually the most powerful world, and it is the source of the six worlds and the foundation of all things."
"You don't realize what's so good about being a strong person?"
"The power of the human heart is the most powerful, and you will understand in the future. Pursuing a higher level of human life does not necessarily mean becoming an immortal. So you don't have to be so persistent in worshiping any teacher, pursuing any Tao, or cultivating any immortals. Whether they are gods or demons, they all have their own troubles. Maybe you are not as simple and happy as a human being."
Hua Qiangu nodded, feeling very reasonable.
"So, are Taoist Master Qingxu and the others considered humans or immortals? At first, I couldn't figure out what kind of gathering of immortals he asked me to attend. How could I, an ordinary person, go there?"
"Didn't you read the "Six Realms Complete Book" he gave you? The classifications and levels should be very clear in it."
"I haven't read it yet. The Banquet of Immortals is on the 13th of next month. It's so far away from Kunlun Mountain. I'm afraid I won't be able to catch up. I've been rushing so hard these days that I fell asleep as soon as I lay down at night and completely forgot about the book."
"The levels of immortals can generally be divided into nine levels according to their magic power and status: the first immortal, the second immortal, the third supreme immortal, the fourth flying immortal, the fifth spiritual immortal, the sixth immortal, the seventh spiritual being, the eighth flying immortal, and the ninth immortal. There are many ways to become an immortal. , Mainly through Buddhism and Taoism, there are also methods such as Heavenly Immortal, Earth Immortal and Zhijie Immortal, which are to die first and then instill immortal power. Of course, it is best to ascend by yourself or become an immortal directly. "
"Oh, so Changliu Immortal is so powerful?"
"What!?" Dongfang Yuqing narrowed his eyes.
"Taoist Priest Qingxu asked me to become my disciple, Changliu Shangxian Baizi Hua."
Dongfang Yuqing snorted coldly, and his warm eyes suddenly became a little arrogant. She didn't know why Hua Qiangu suddenly felt that he was a bit arrogant.familiar.
"They have become immortals. Will they still care about worldly affairs and accept disciples?" In the past, she always felt that immortals were aloof and difficult to see.
"In today's world, demons are rampant, and there is almost no big boundary between those who have become immortals and cultivators. Except for the Heavenly Court, which is located above the Nine Heavens, other immortals, whether they are titled or scattered immortals, mostly live in peach gardens in the mountains and overseas fairy islands. In this paradise, everyone can visit immortals to seek fate. To put it bluntly, immortals are not as lofty as the world describes. They are just more powerful and less lustful than ordinary people, and they are more likely to fall into the devil's path. "
Hua Qiangu heard the faint disdain for immortals in his words and didn't know what to say for a moment. So who is her future master?
"Then Taoist Priest Qingxu should also be an immortal, right?"
"He? He must be a real person. Do you think it is so easy to become an immortal? There are only four immortals left in the entire immortal world."
